An '''individual''' served as an important agent of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]<ref name="CSWE Klev">{{CSWECite|II|221|Klev, Captain Titus}}</ref> following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|319|Wann Tsir}}</ref> The agent unsuccessfully attempted to [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] the [[Planetary shield/Legends|deflector shield]]<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wann Tsir]].<ref name="CSWE" />
